text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone who cheered for me is smiling, and 
that makes it super Bono☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, I want to ask you too... how was my 
run today?
choice_data_list: Could use just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, seeing you smile too, Trainer, makes me so 
happy~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: When I see your smile, Trainer, somehow—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I feel safe... and now I’m getting hungry~!
choice_data_list: <size=30>Let’s celebrate with chanko hotpot when we get back!</size>
<size=30>We’ll celebrate with chanko hotpot when we get back!</size>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay☆ I’ll eat a ton and give it my all next time 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh... does that mean it wasn’t enough?
choice_data_list: You can bring out even more smiles!
<size=30>You’re someone who can bring out even more smiles!</size>

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course! Leave it to me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, my arms are itching to go! I’ll turn the whole 
venue into a smiling chanko hotpot~!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the next race ahead, Hishi Akebono looks more 
than fired up!
